lines.text: Paul says this is the third time he is coming, and he warned them already on his second visit.
Paul says Christ was crucified in weakness, yet lives by God's power, and is powerful among them.
Paul tells the Corinthians to examine themselves to see whether they are in the hope.
Paul writes while absent so he need not be severe with the authority the Lord gave him for tearing down.
Paul tells them to live in peace, greet one another with a holy kiss, and ends with the Spirit's fellowship.
